summary: SSE-accelerated 3x3 matrix x integer 3-vector transform. Loads the output-vector working buffer pointer from this+0x10 and the matrix-column buffer pointer from this+0x30, copies the three input vector components (a2) and the three matrix columns (a4[0..2]) into those buffers, then computes the transform as a sum of per-column dot products via SSE shuffle/mul/add. Stores the three resulting components to a3 and returns the first component.

local_names.a1: owning object holding the working buffers
local_names.a4: three __m128 matrix columns (row-major 3x3 as three columns)

Copy the three input vector components a2[0..2] into the vector working buffer at *(this+0x10) (+0x0, +0x4, +0x8)
Copy the three matrix columns a4[0], a4[1], a4[2] into the matrix buffer at *(this+0x30) at offsets +0x0, +0x10, +0x20
Matrix-vector product: result = shuffle(v7,0)*col0 + shuffle(v7,85)*col1 + shuffle(v7,170)*col2, broadcasting each vector component and summing the three column products with SSE add/mul
Store the three computed components of the transform result from the working buffer into output a3[0..2]
Return the first transformed component (the value stored to a3[0])
